environment.tool: scripts/probes/rce/row.py sweep 2026-11-18 (control-first, exact request bytes, executing peer)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET /api/x?a%0d%0aGET%20/exec%3fcmd=id%0d%0aHost:%20u%0d%0a%20HTTP/1.1 HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `063b0d5e:49` (`process`) and `:56` (`c.uto=method+" "+upath`).
findings.title: request_line_split: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['POST /api/x HTTP/1.1', 'GET /api/exec?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `063b0d5e:53` (`h.count` after `h[...]`), `:57` (`req_done=length==0`).
findings.title: body_replay_desync: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

findings.description: Driven by scripts/probes/rce/row.py against the tagged release. Observed: control 200, upstream saw ['GET /exec ?cmd=id HTTP/1.1']. Root cause at `063b0d5e:56` (`c.uto=...upath...`, quoted `proxy_pass` keeps the space).
findings.title: config_quoted_space: verified upstream-side RCE (high)

limitations: Covers the eight request-smuggling RCE families of the rce_matrix; static-only findings from the earlier audits are recorded in their own envelopes.
methods: row.py cell harness with benign control, fresh peer and proxy per cell, exact bytes from cells.json

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run
verified: release tag resolves to the submitted source
source SHA-256 and report and evidence hashes

scope: Empirical RCE verification of the tagged release: every positive cell of the rce_matrix driven with real request bytes; a cell passes only on an upstream-side effect.
